name: Mr. Kurosaki's Pure Love Never Stops
original_name: 黒崎さんの一途な愛がとまらない
overview: High schooler Koharu has never experienced love—until a mysterious regular at her family’s bento shop surprises her with a marriage proposal and a fortune. Thrust into his relentless, over-the-top devotion, she must navigate the whirlwind of first love.
